status: Proposed (2026-10-09): openspec/changes/crew-on-deck section 7, the owner's rule of 2026-10-09 ("50% health the player moves at half speed; lower than 20% the player or crew bot is incapacitated"). Read by docs/mockups/lib/shipsystems.js (the falling vitals, for every body) and docs/mockups/fire.html (the walking player's speed and the incapacitated overlay). Its own file, not a block of walk.json, because sc-core::walk reads walk.json with unknown fields refused; the engine takes these numbers when crew-on-deck section 7 is built.
